teaching.title: Peer Programming Mentor
bullets: Supported beginner practice sessions covering variables and conditionals, lists and dictionaries as a peer programming mentor.
Explained worked examples on these programming topics under a course instructor's supervision during beginner practice sessions.

projects.title: Library Catalogue Program
bullets: Implemented a small Python command-line library catalogue program using functions and collections for an individual undergraduate course project.
Tested example inputs and documented the library catalogue program's behaviour, using Git for the project.
